LBY.note: Only a ministry's digital transformation plan is mentioned, not a national strategy.
No link between systems is stated.

facts.fact: Libya's Ministry of Social Affairs says families in the wife-and-children grant programme registered and updated their data through the ministry's electronic platforms, and arrears are paid only to beneficiaries whose data were completed and approved.

LBY.note: A single database is only an aim of the ministry's plan; no registry is stated as built or in service.
